description: Election Commission - Declare that N. K. V. M. A. Hemantha as a member of the Matara Pradesiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Matara Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for a local government body, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new elected member, which falls under the Elections classification type.
